challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I need the evaluation harness to run automatically so I can test new weather features without waiting for a manual queue. The northern region is already showing significant drift in seasonal demand during heat events, and the current forecast misses the mark badly on those articles. If I can iterate on the feature set overnight, I can catch those shifts before the next promotion week locks in. Every additional hour spent on manual documentation delays the model update, which means more residual stock in the warehouse. I want the system to flag when a new feature improves accuracy so I can move it to production immediately.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that being able to iterate overnight would allow them to catch demand shifts before a deadline, indicating that fulfilling this need for speed would make them happier by reducing stock risk.
